meta.name: story-generator
meta.description: Decompose features, epics, or technical designs into granular, implementation-ready User Stories (PRODUCT-CODE-XXX). Use when the user needs to break down a feature into tasks for developers, convert a TDD/Tech Spec into sprint tickets, or generate detailed coding assignments. Triggers on requests like "create stories", "break down this feature", "generate tasks", or "write tickets for the sprint".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把功能或技术方案拆成开发可直接落地的编号任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需把功能需求与技术设计拆解成开发任务
copy.tagline_en: Break features and designs into numbered, dev-ready user stories.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn feature requests into implementable tasks for your team.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会把功能说明或技术设计拆成一个个开发人员可直接开工的小任务,标上代号、所属层、验收标准和依赖关系,并按顺序列出。如果没有现成文档,它会先问你产品代号、技术栈等问题。
howto.when: 当你想把功能、史诗或技术设计拆成开发人员任务,或把 TDD/技术规格转成 sprint 票时,说“创建故事”“拆解这个功能”“生成任务”等都会触发。

say.text: 把登录功能拆成开发故事,按依赖顺序排好。
say.note: 会生成带代号和验收标准的任务列表。

say.text: 把这份 TDD 规格转成 sprint 票,标出阻塞关系。
say.note: 会读取文档并输出原子化技术故事。

say.text: 拆解支付功能,先问我产品代号和范围再生成。
say.note: 会先访谈补充上下文再分解。

howto.what_en: Claude breaks features or tech designs into atomic dev tasks marked with codes, layers, acceptance criteria, and dependencies, then lists them in order. Without docs, it asks for product code, scope, and stack.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users ask to 'create stories', 'break down this feature', or 'generate tasks', or need features split into dev tasks / TDDs turned into sprint tickets.

say_en.text: Break down the login feature into dev stories, ordered by dependencies.
say_en.note: It outputs tasks with IDs and acceptance criteria.

say_en.text: Convert this TDD spec into sprint tickets, marking blockers.
say_en.note: It reads the doc and generates atomic technical stories.

say_en.text: Decompose payment into stories; ask for product code and scope first.
say_en.note: It asks for context before generating.
